C-CONSOLIDATION-369.Summary: Consolidate confirmed audit defects in authentication UI, review bulk writes and duplicated frontend code without changing schema or the canonical business workflow.
C-CONSOLIDATION-369.Problem: The 0.4.11 runtime retains unreachable frontend generations, system password prompts, silent Plan/Fact refresh failures and a bulk AI review path that can overwrite a newer non-empty meeting value.

Goals.Goal: Remove only proven dead frontend modules.
Use masked application-owned dialogs for account password changes and administrator reset without changing PIN/account authorization semantics.
Preserve newer manual meeting date/protocol values during bulk AI repair.
Expose Plan/Fact failures and move technical template type under existing progressive disclosure.

Constraints.Constraint: Acceptance authority is issue 369. Exact runtime base is 2bf802f6612c14667773e4d58f72b3dd9acfb9fd.
SQLite schema remains 31; applied migrations, immutable source/evidence and ACL policy are unchanged.
Bulk AI repair may fill an empty field or confirm the same current value, but must not overwrite a conflicting non-empty current value.
No mandatory LLM/cloud/service and no parallel task/document registry.
Project CI and targeted auth/browser tests own functional evidence; GRACE owns risk scope/lint.

NonGoals.NonGoal: New product features, schema migrations, release workflow redesign or physical Astra acceptance.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: lifecycle-next.js and plan-fact-origin.js are absent while current lifecycle/PlanFact entries remain.
Active account password change and admin reset use masked application dialogs with cancellation and inline errors.
Bulk AI cannot overwrite conflicting current meeting date/protocol; skipped review stays open.
Plan/Fact user actions expose failures instead of empty catches.
Technical template document type remains compatible but is under additional fields.
npm run check, npm test, npm run smoke, test:browser:auth and test:browser:plan-fact pass on exact head.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Exact-head CI plus auth, review-write and Plan/Fact regression evidence; no migration gate because schema is unchanged.
